from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
import time
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx
import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.trustedhost import TrustedHostMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, StreamingResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationError


def _env_bool(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    value = os.getenv(name)
    if value is None:
        return default
    return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _env_list(name: str, default: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    value = os.getenv(name)
    if value is None or not value.strip():
        return default
    return [item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip()]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    app_name: str = os.getenv("APP_NAME", "Claude Chat Backend")
    app_env: str = os.getenv("APP_ENV", "production")
    host: str = os.getenv("HOST", "0.0.0.0")
    port: int = int(os.getenv("PORT", "8000"))
    log_level: str = os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO").upper()
    allowed_origins: list[str] = None
    allowed_hosts: list[str] = None
    anthropic_api_key: str | None = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
    anthropic_base_url: str = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL", "")
    anthropic_version: str = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_VERSION", "2023-06-01")
    anthropic_model: str = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_MODEL", "claude-opus-4-7")
    anthropic_max_tokens: int = int(os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS", "128000"))
    anthropic_temperature: float = float(os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_TEMPERATURE", "0"))
    anthropic_reasoning_enabled: bool = _env_bool("ANTHROPIC_REASONING_ENABLED", True)
    anthropic_reasoning_type: str = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_REASONING_TYPE", "adaptive")
    anthropic_timeout_seconds: float = float(os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "900"))
    connect_timeout_seconds: float = float(os.getenv("CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "30"))
    read_timeout_seconds: float = float(os.getenv("READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "900"))
    write_timeout_seconds: float = float(os.getenv("WRITE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "900"))
    pool_timeout_seconds: float = float(os.getenv("POOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "30"))
    max_request_chars: int = int(os.getenv("MAX_REQUEST_CHARS", "400000"))
    rate_limit_requests: int = int(os.getenv("RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS", "120"))
    rate_limit_window_seconds: int = int(os.getenv("RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS", "60"))
    send_default_system_prompt: bool = _env_bool("SEND_DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT", False)
    default_system_prompt: str = os.getenv("DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT", "")

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "allowed_origins", _env_list("ALLOWED_ORIGINS", ["*"]))
        object.__setattr__(self, "allowed_hosts", _env_list("ALLOWED_HOSTS", ["*"]))


settings = Settings()

logging.basicConfig(
    level=getattr(logging, settings.log_level, logging.INFO),
    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("claude-chat-backend")

rate_buckets: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)
rate_lock = asyncio.Lock()


class ChatMessage(BaseModel):
    role: Literal["user", "assistant"]
    content: Any

    model_config = {"extra": "forbid"}


class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    messages: list[ChatMessage] = Field(min_length=1)
    system: str | list[str] | None = None
    max_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=128000)
    temperature: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    reasoning: bool | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    include_reasoning: bool = False

    model_config = {"extra": "forbid"}


class StreamChatRequest(BaseModel):
    messages: list[ChatMessage] = Field(min_length=1)
    system: str | list[str] | None = None
    max_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=128000)
    temperature: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1)
    reasoning: bool | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    model_config = {"extra": "forbid"}


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    timeout = httpx.Timeout(
        timeout=settings.anthropic_timeout_seconds,
        connect=settings.connect_timeout_seconds,
        read=settings.read_timeout_seconds,
        write=settings.write_timeout_seconds,
        pool=settings.pool_timeout_seconds,
    )
    limits = httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=100, max_connections=200)
    app.state.http = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout, limits=limits, http2=True)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        await app.state.http.aclose()


app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name, version="1.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1024)
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.allowed_origins,
    allow_credentials=False,
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
    expose_headers=["X-Request-ID"],
)
app.add_middleware(TrustedHostMiddleware, allowed_hosts=settings.allowed_hosts)


@app.middleware("http")
async def request_context_middleware(request: Request, call_next):
    request_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-ID") or str(uuid.uuid4())
    request.state.request_id = request_id
    client_ip = _client_ip(request)
    await _enforce_rate_limit(client_ip)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        response = await call_next(request)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("unhandled_error request_id=%s", request_id)
        response = JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            content={
                "error": {
                    "type": "internal_server_error",
                    "message": "Internal server error",
                    "request_id": request_id,
                }
            },
        )
    elapsed_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
    response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
    response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "same-origin"
    response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
    response.headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
    response.headers["Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"] = "same-origin"
    response.headers["Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy"] = "cross-origin"
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    logger.info(
        "%s %s status=%s duration_ms=%s ip=%s request_id=%s",
        request.method,
        request.url.path,
        response.status_code,
        elapsed_ms,
        client_ip,
        request_id,
    )
    return response


@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
async def request_validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        content={
            "error": {
                "type": "validation_error",
                "message": "Invalid request payload",
                "details": exc.errors(),
                "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
            }
        },
    )


@app.exception_handler(ValidationError)
async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: ValidationError):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        content={
            "error": {
                "type": "validation_error",
                "message": "Invalid data",
                "details": exc.errors(),
                "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
            }
        },
    )


@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException):
    payload = exc.detail if isinstance(exc.detail, dict) else {"message": str(exc.detail)}
    payload.setdefault("request_id", getattr(request.state, "request_id", None))
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content={"error": payload})


@app.get("/")
async def root() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": settings.app_name,
        "environment": settings.app_env,
        "model": settings.anthropic_model,
        "reasoning": settings.anthropic_reasoning_enabled,
    }


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "model": settings.anthropic_model,
        "reasoning": settings.anthropic_reasoning_enabled,
    }


@app.get("/ready")
async def ready(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not settings.anthropic_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail={"type": "configuration_error", "message": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not configured"},
        )
    client: httpx.AsyncClient = request.app.state.http
    response = await client.get(f"{settings.anthropic_base_url.rstrip('/')}/v1/models", headers=_anthropic_headers())
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        _raise_anthropic_http_error(response)
    return {"status": "ready"}


@app.post("/api/chat")
async def chat(request: Request, payload: ChatRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    _ensure_configured()
    anthropic_payload = _build_payload(
        messages=payload.messages,
        system=payload.system,
        max_tokens=payload.max_tokens,
        temperature=payload.temperature,
        reasoning=payload.reasoning,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    client: httpx.AsyncClient = request.app.state.http
    response = await client.post(
        f"{settings.anthropic_base_url.rstrip('/')}/v1/messages",
        headers=_anthropic_headers(),
        json=anthropic_payload,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        _raise_anthropic_http_error(response)
    data = response.json()
    content = data.get("content", [])
    text_parts = []
    reasoning_parts = []
    for block in content:
        block_type = block.get("type")
        if block_type == "text":
            text_parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
        elif block_type == "thinking":
            reasoning_parts.append(block.get("thinking", ""))
    return {
        "id": data.get("id"),
        "model": data.get("model"),
        "role": data.get("role", "assistant"),
        "text": "".join(text_parts),
        "reasoning": "".join(reasoning_parts) if payload.include_reasoning else None,
        "stop_reason": data.get("stop_reason"),
        "stop_sequence": data.get("stop_sequence"),
        "usage": data.get("usage", {}),
        "request_id": request.state.request_id,
    }


@app.post("/api/chat/stream")
async def chat_stream(request: Request, payload: StreamChatRequest) -> StreamingResponse:
    _ensure_configured()
    anthropic_payload = _build_payload(
        messages=payload.messages,
        system=payload.system,
        max_tokens=payload.max_tokens,
        temperature=payload.temperature,
        reasoning=payload.reasoning,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
        stream=True,
    )

    async def event_generator():
        client: httpx.AsyncClient = request.app.state.http
        text_parts: list[str] = []
        reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
        usage: dict[str, Any] = {}
        message_id: str | None = None
        model: str | None = None
        stop_reason: str | None = None
        try:
            async with client.stream(
                "POST",
                f"{settings.anthropic_base_url.rstrip('/')}/v1/messages",
                headers=_anthropic_headers(),
                json=anthropic_payload,
            ) as response:
                if response.status_code >= 400:
                    body = await response.aread()
                    yield _sse("error", {"message": _extract_error_message(body), "request_id": request.state.request_id})
                    return
                event_name: str | None = None
                data_lines: list[str] = []
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if await request.is_disconnected():
                        return
                    if line == "":
                        if data_lines:
                            parsed = _parse_sse_event(event_name, data_lines)
                            event_name = None
                            data_lines = []
                            if parsed is None:
                                continue
                            name, data = parsed
                            if name == "message_start":
                                message = data.get("message", {})
                                message_id = message.get("id")
                                model = message.get("model")
                                usage = message.get("usage", {}) or {}
                                yield _sse(
                                    "message_start",
                                    {
                                        "id": message_id,
                                        "model": model,
                                        "usage": usage,
                                        "request_id": request.state.request_id,
                                    },
                                )
                            elif name == "content_block_delta":
                                delta = data.get("delta", {})
                                delta_type = delta.get("type")
                                if delta_type == "text_delta":
                                    chunk = delta.get("text", "")
                                    if chunk:
                                        text_parts.append(chunk)
                                        yield _sse("text", {"delta": chunk})
                                elif delta_type == "thinking_delta":
                                    chunk = delta.get("thinking", "")
                                    if chunk:
                                        reasoning_parts.append(chunk)
                                        yield _sse("thinking", {"delta": chunk})
                            elif name == "message_delta":
                                usage.update(data.get("usage", {}) or {})
                                stop_reason = data.get("delta", {}).get("stop_reason") or stop_reason
                                yield _sse("message_delta", {"usage": usage, "stop_reason": stop_reason})
                            elif name == "message_stop":
                                yield _sse(
                                    "done",
                                    {
                                        "id": message_id,
                                        "model": model,
                                        "text": "".join(text_parts),
                                        "reasoning": "".join(reasoning_parts),
                                        "usage": usage,
                                        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                                        "request_id": request.state.request_id,
                                    },
                                )
                                return
                            elif name == "error":
                                yield _sse("error", {"message": data.get("error", {}).get("message", "Upstream error")})
                                return
                    elif line.startswith("event:"):
                        event_name = line[6:].strip()
                    elif line.startswith("data:"):
                        data_lines.append(line[5:].lstrip())
                yield _sse(
                    "done",
                    {
                        "id": message_id,
                        "model": model,
                        "text": "".join(text_parts),
                        "reasoning": "".join(reasoning_parts),
                        "usage": usage,
                        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                        "request_id": request.state.request_id,
                    },
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("stream_error request_id=%s", request.state.request_id)
            yield _sse("error", {"message": str(exc), "request_id": request.state.request_id})

    headers = {
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
        "Connection": "keep-alive",
        "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
    }
    return StreamingResponse(event_generator(), media_type="text/event-stream", headers=headers)


def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")
    if forwarded:
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    if request.client:
        return request.client.host
    return "unknown"


async def _enforce_rate_limit(client_ip: str) -> None:
    now = time.time()
    async with rate_lock:
        bucket = rate_buckets[client_ip]
        while bucket and now - bucket[0] > settings.rate_limit_window_seconds:
            bucket.popleft()
        if len(bucket) >= settings.rate_limit_requests:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                detail={"type": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Too many requests"},
            )
        bucket.append(now)


def _ensure_configured() -> None:
    if not settings.anthropic_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail={"type": "configuration_error", "message": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not configured"},
        )


def _anthropic_headers() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "x-api-key": settings.anthropic_api_key or "",
        "anthropic-version": settings.anthropic_version,
        "content-type": "application/json",
        "accept": "application/json",
    }


def _normalize_system(system: str | list[str] | None) -> str | None:
    if system is None:
        if settings.send_default_system_prompt and settings.default_system_prompt.strip():
            return settings.default_system_prompt.strip()
        return None
    if isinstance(system, list):
        parts = [part.strip() for part in system if isinstance(part, str) and part.strip()]
        if not parts:
            return None
        value = "\n\n".join(parts)
    elif isinstance(system, str):
        value = system.strip()
    else:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "system must be a string or list of strings"},
        )
    if len(value) > settings.max_request_chars:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "system prompt is too large"},
        )
    return value or None


def _normalize_content(content: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        value = content.strip()
        if not value:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "message content cannot be empty"},
            )
        if len(value) > settings.max_request_chars:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
                detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "message content is too large"},
            )
        return [{"type": "text", "text": value}]
    if not isinstance(content, list) or not content:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "message content must be a non-empty string or block list"},
        )
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    total_chars = 0
    for item in content:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "content blocks must be objects"},
            )
        block_type = item.get("type")
        if block_type == "text":
            text = item.get("text")
            if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "text blocks must include non-empty text"},
                )
            text = text.strip()
            total_chars += len(text)
            normalized.append({"type": "text", "text": text})
        elif block_type == "image":
            source = item.get("source")
            if not isinstance(source, dict):
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "image blocks must include a source object"},
                )
            source_type = source.get("type")
            media_type = source.get("media_type")
            data = source.get("data")
            if source_type != "base64" or not isinstance(media_type, str) or not isinstance(data, str) or not data:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "image source must contain base64 data and media_type"},
                )
            normalized.append(
                {
                    "type": "image",
                    "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": media_type, "data": data},
                }
            )
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": f"unsupported content block type: {block_type}"},
            )
    if total_chars > settings.max_request_chars:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "message content is too large"},
        )
    return normalized


def _merge_messages(messages: list[ChatMessage]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    merged: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for message in messages:
        blocks = _normalize_content(message.content)
        if merged and merged[-1]["role"] == message.role:
            merged[-1]["content"].extend(blocks)
        else:
            merged.append({"role": message.role, "content": blocks})
    if not merged:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "at least one message is required"},
        )
    if merged[0]["role"] != "user":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "the first message must have role 'user'"},
        )
    return merged


def _build_payload(
    messages: list[ChatMessage],
    system: str | list[str] | None,
    max_tokens: int | None,
    temperature: float | None,
    reasoning: bool | None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None,
    stream: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized_messages = _merge_messages(messages)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": settings.anthropic_model,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens if max_tokens is not None else settings.anthropic_max_tokens,
        "temperature": temperature if temperature is not None else settings.anthropic_temperature,
        "messages": normalized_messages,
        "stream": stream,
    }
    system_value = _normalize_system(system)
    if system_value is not None:
        payload["system"] = system_value
    if reasoning if reasoning is not None else settings.anthropic_reasoning_enabled:
        payload["thinking"] = {"type": settings.anthropic_reasoning_type}
    if metadata is not None:
        payload["metadata"] = metadata
    return payload


def _raise_anthropic_http_error(response: httpx.Response) -> None:
    try:
        data = response.json()
    except Exception:
        data = None
    message = None
    error_type = "upstream_error"
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        error = data.get("error")
        if isinstance(error, dict):
            message = error.get("message")
            error_type = error.get("type") or error_type
    if not message:
        message = response.text or "Upstream request failed"
    raise HTTPException(status_code=response.status_code, detail={"type": error_type, "message": message})


def _parse_sse_event(event_name: str | None, data_lines: list[str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]] | None:
    name = (event_name or "message").strip()
    raw = "\n".join(data_lines).strip()
    if not raw:
        return None
    if raw == "[DONE]":
        return "message_stop", {}
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return name, {"raw": raw}
    return name, data


def _sse(event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return f"event: {event}\ndata: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))}\n\n"


def _extract_error_message(body: bytes) -> str:
    if not body:
        return "Upstream request failed"
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            error = parsed.get("error")

def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")
    if forwarded:
        return forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
    if request.client:
        return request.client.host
    return "unknown"


async def _enforce_rate_limit(client_ip: str) -> None:
    now = time.time()
    async with rate_lock:
        bucket = rate_buckets[client_ip]
        while bucket and now - bucket[0] > settings.rate_limit_window_seconds:
            bucket.popleft()
        if len(bucket) >= settings.rate_limit_requests:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                detail={"type": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Too many requests"},
            )
        bucket.append(now)


def _ensure_configured() -> None:
    if not settings.anthropic_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail={"type": "configuration_error", "message": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not configured"},
        )


def _anthropic_headers() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "x-api-key": settings.anthropic_api_key or "",
        "anthropic-version": settings.anthropic_version,
        "content-type": "application/json",
        "accept": "application/json",
    }


def _normalize_system(system: str | list[str] | None) -> str | None:
    if system is None:
        if settings.send_default_system_prompt and settings.default_system_prompt.strip():
            return settings.default_system_prompt.strip()
        return None
    if isinstance(system, list):
        parts = [part.strip() for part in system if isinstance(part, str) and part.strip()]
        if not parts:
            return None
        value = "\n\n".join(parts)
    elif isinstance(system, str):
        value = system.strip()
    else:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "system must be a string or list of strings"},
        )
    if len(value) > settings.max_request_chars:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "system prompt is too large"},
        )
    return value or None


def _normalize_content(content: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        value = content.strip()
        if not value:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "message content cannot be empty"},
            )
        if len(value) > settings.max_request_chars:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
                detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "message content is too large"},
            )
        return [{"type": "text", "text": value}]
    if not isinstance(content, list) or not content:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "message content must be a non-empty string or block list"},
        )
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    total_chars = 0
    for item in content:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "content blocks must be objects"},
            )
        block_type = item.get("type")
        if block_type == "text":
            text = item.get("text")
            if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "text blocks must include non-empty text"},
                )
            text = text.strip()
            total_chars += len(text)
            normalized.append({"type": "text", "text": text})
        elif block_type == "image":
            source = item.get("source")
            if not isinstance(source, dict):
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "image blocks must include a source object"},
                )
            source_type = source.get("type")
            media_type = source.get("media_type")
            data = source.get("data")
            if source_type != "base64" or not isinstance(media_type, str) or not isinstance(data, str) or not data:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "image source must contain base64 data and media_type"},
                )
            normalized.append(
                {
                    "type": "image",
                    "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": media_type, "data": data},
                }
            )
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": f"unsupported content block type: {block_type}"},
            )
    if total_chars > settings.max_request_chars:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE,
            detail={"type": "payload_too_large", "message": "message content is too large"},
        )
    return normalized


def _merge_messages(messages: list[ChatMessage]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    merged: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for message in messages:
        blocks = _normalize_content(message.content)
        if merged and merged[-1]["role"] == message.role:
            merged[-1]["content"].extend(blocks)
        else:
            merged.append({"role": message.role, "content": blocks})
    if not merged:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "at least one message is required"},
        )
    if merged[0]["role"] != "user":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail={"type": "validation_error", "message": "the first message must have role 'user'"},
        )
    return merged


def _build_payload(
    messages: list[ChatMessage],
    system: str | list[str] | None,
    max_tokens: int | None,
    temperature: float | None,
    reasoning: bool | None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None,
    stream: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized_messages = _merge_messages(messages)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": settings.anthropic_model,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens if max_tokens is not None else settings.anthropic_max_tokens,
        "temperature": temperature if temperature is not None else settings.anthropic_temperature,
        "messages": normalized_messages,
        "stream": stream,
    }
    system_value = _normalize_system(system)
    if system_value is not None:
        payload["system"] = system_value
    if reasoning if reasoning is not None else settings.anthropic_reasoning_enabled:
        payload["thinking"] = {"type": settings.anthropic_reasoning_type}
    if metadata is not None:
        payload["metadata"] = metadata
    return payload


def _raise_anthropic_http_error(response: httpx.Response) -> None:
    try:
        data = response.json()
    except Exception:
        data = None
    message = None
    error_type = "upstream_error"
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        error = data.get("error")
        if isinstance(error, dict):
            message = error.get("message")
            error_type = error.get("type") or error_type
    if not message:
        message = response.text or "Upstream request failed"
    raise HTTPException(status_code=response.status_code, detail={"type": error_type, "message": message})


def _parse_sse_event(event_name: str | None, data_lines: list[str]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]] | None:
    name = (event_name or "message").strip()
    raw = "\n".join(data_lines).strip()
    if not raw:
        return None
    if raw == "[DONE]":
        return "message_stop", {}
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return name, {"raw": raw}
    return name, data


def _sse(event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return f"event: {event}\ndata: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))}\n\n"


def _extract_error_message(body: bytes) -> str:
    if not body:
        return "Upstream request failed"
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            error = parsed.get("error")
            if isinstance(error, dict) and error.get("message"):
                return str(error["message"])
    except Exception:
        pass
    text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
    return text or "Upstream request failed"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("main:app", host=settings.host, port=settings.port, reload=False)
